text:
[NADP.1.2] Adapters run **in the same process** as
libds. Cross-process bridging — HA running in a
separate process, MQTT broker on another host —
happens at the adapter's outer edge (HA-bridge talks
to HA over the WebSocket API; MQTT-bridge talks to
the broker via its native protocol). libds sees only
the C-API calls the adapter makes.
